awards:
第60届柏林国际电影节(2010)
　　主竞赛单元 最佳短片(提名)
introduction: Matabeleland, Zimbabwe, 1980s: Elizabeth, a young and talented storyteller arrives at a guerilla camp desperate for help: her life and the lives of the other villagers are in danger.The soldiers demand a story so she spins them a tale, weaving fact with illusion. About her village, strangers and ghosts. About how her father dug a tunnel to the city and her journey to find him.But reality is not so far behind and to save her village, Elizabeth will have to confront the truth.
